name: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai
englishBachelors: Engineering, computing, business and information technology, awarding the American RIT degree.
note: An American technical university's Dubai campus in Silicon Oasis, with the same curriculum and degree as Rochester, New York — including RIT's cooperative-education model of paid industry placements. Students can transfer to the US campus.
summary: Dubai campus of Rochester Institute of Technology (US) in Silicon Oasis, with 13 bachelor's degrees in engineering, computing, business, psychology and design, issued by RIT in New York.
about: Degrees are issued directly from RIT in New York and taught in English. The programmes use paid co-operative education, and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis for both September and January starts.

ib.text: Minimum 24 IB points for most degrees; Engineering needs 28 points with Maths, Physics and Chemistry or Biology at 4+. Two IB certificates at grade 3+ can count only with a BTEC (IBCP) route.

notes: IB entry: RIT Dubai's page lists a minimum of 24 IB points for Business, Computing and the other non-engineering degrees. The Engineering requirements sheet raises this to 28 points and asks for at least 4 in Maths, Physics and one of Chemistry or Biology. The IB level (HL or SL) is not stated. This is a minimum, and admission is selective.

IB Course Results: the page's only IB-certificate route is the IB Career-related Programme: a BTEC Level 3 relevant to your degree plus an IB subject certificate in two subjects (HL or SL) with at least grade 3 in each. Single certificates alone are not stated to be enough.

Selection: admission is selective and personal. RIT Dubai considers school performance in required subjects, admission test scores, the competitiveness of your school, the programme, and may use recommendations and an interview. Predicted marks are acceptable for a conditional decision until final marks arrive.

English proof: full admission with IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL ITP 550 or EmSAT English 1550. Lower scores (IELTS 5.0-6.0, TOEFL iBT 61-78) give conditional admission with English courses first. IELTS Indicator, Duolingo, PTE and home-based TOEFL are not accepted. The page does not offer an IB English waiver.

Dates: the page lists Fall early admission until 15 January, regular admission until 31 May and an application deadline of 22 August, but gives no year. They are shown as provisional for Fall 2027. Applications after the deadline are reviewed if space remains. It advises applying early because scholarship places are limited.
Tests: all freshmen take placement tests: Maths and Physics for engineering, Maths for business, computing and psychology. IB Higher Level results may earn exemption depending on final grades.

Tuition: AED 68,000 a year (about USD 18,516) for all bachelor's programmes, under the table headed 'students admitted effective Fall 2023'. The page says RIT Dubai may revise fees without notice, so the 2027-28 fee is not confirmed. Extra pre-university courses cost AED 4,960 to AED 9,975 per semester.

Scholarships: academic awards of 5% to 45% by high school percentage (80% to 98%+), plus a 30% Dean's award; apply after acceptance. The page gives no IB conversion; ask how IB results are mapped. Awards last one academic year and are re-evaluated.

Duration is stated for few programmes. Only Mechanical Engineering (four years) and the Computing and Information Technologies flowchart (four years) are listed; the other degrees show no duration on their pages.

programmes.overview: The first two years cover mathematics, physics, chemistry, liberal arts and engineering sciences; the third and fourth years emphasise engineering science, design and systems. The major includes professional cooperative education. Labs include 3D printers, testing machines and a machine shop.
